setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Two 8-step channels at 90 BPM. Channel 1 has Pattern 1 (C D E F on steps 1 to 4) as its Foundation anchor and Pattern 2 (trigs on steps 5 and 7) as additions. Channel 2 (MIDI channel 2) has Pattern 3, one trig on step 5, as its Foundation anchor, and is channel 1's Interlock leader with Window 0. Interlock ON removes a channel 1 addition that lands on the leader's anchor, so channel 1's grid shows steps 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 lit. Anchor gap is 0: Gap is a safety distance, 0 to 8 steps, kept clear of additions around an anchor, and 0 turns it off. Every step below is on channel 1 under Channel tasks > Merge Shape (E1 to Channel tasks, E2 to Merge Shape, K3); Result, Reason and Rhythm are screens of that list.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Open Result and turn E3 to Step 7. Result shows Decision OK: the addition on step 7 is admitted.
steps.title: Open Result for step 7

steps.caption: Select Reason and press K3. Merge Reason lists Step 7, Role ADDITION P2 (an addition taken from Pattern 2), Decision OK, Interlock ON, Velocity 70 and Pitch target LEGACY.

assertion.characterisation: characterisation outside legacy README: suppressed Role is EMPTY P2 and Velocity is NONE

steps.title: Inspect an admitted addition

steps.caption: Return to Result and turn E3 to Step 5. Result shows Decision INTERLOCK CH02: this addition is refused.
steps.title: Open Result for step 5

steps.caption: Open Reason again. Step 5 sits on the leader's anchor, so Role reads EMPTY P2, Decision reads INTERLOCK CH02 and Velocity reads NONE. The addition was refused and sends no note. EMPTY P2 does not mean Pattern 2 lacks a trig on step 5.

assertion.characterisation: characterisation outside legacy README: suppressed Role is EMPTY P2 and Velocity is NONE

steps.title: Inspect an Interlock rejection

steps.caption: Open Rhythm, select Anchor gap, turn E3 once right to 1 and press K3. Anchor gap 1 keeps additions one step clear of an anchor, and step 5 is now next to the anchor on step 4 as well as on the leader's anchor.
steps.title: Set Anchor gap to 1

steps.caption: Open Result and select Step 5. Decision now reads GAP, INTERLOCK: two reasons are listed.
steps.title: Read the two reasons in Result

steps.caption: Open Reason for Step 5: Decision reads GAP, INTERLOCK, with Gap listed first.

assertion.characterisation: characterisation outside legacy README: suppressed Role is EMPTY P2 and Velocity is NONE

steps.title: Inspect two rejection reasons

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8) for two loops, then Stop. Channel 1 plays C D E F on steps 1 to 4 and its addition on step 7. Step 5 stays silent on channel 1 even though Pattern 2 has a trig there.
steps.title: Play the filtered pattern
